title: Nodes
description: What deployment.nodes answers: the deployment's nodes, each with how many agents run on it, how many of those work, wait or wait on a person, and how many sleep on none.

name.description: The node's name, as an agent's node is given.

agents.description: How many agents run on it.

running.description: How many agents on the nodes answer a message now.

idle.description: How many agents on the nodes wait for a message.

parked.description: How many agents on the nodes wait on a person to decide.

asleep.description: How many agents sleep, on no node, until something asks them.
